topic: Procedure for upgrading AOG demand and raising of AOG occurrence/ clearance signal
syllabus_extract: Procedure for upgrading AOG demand and raising of AOG occurrence/ clearance signal
specific_objectives: 4.1.6.1 Trainee will be able to describe AOG procedure and follow up action.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of AOG signal flow chart and verification of upgrade criteria against IB guidelines
intro_questions: What is the primary definition of an Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situation?
List three common causes that trigger an AOG demand.
Who is the initial authority responsible for declaring an AOG?

development.content:
Criteria for upgrading AOG demand
Documentation required for upgrade
Notification chain for AOG upgrade
Verification of spare parts availability
Approval authority for AOG upgrade

Raising AOG occurrence signal procedure
Raising AOG clearance signal procedure
Communication protocols for signals
Recording signal details in logbooks
Escalation path for unresolved signals

Follow-up actions post-signal raising
Coordination with Depot maintenance
Reporting timelines for AOG resolution
Impact assessment on flight schedule
Final clearance verification steps

summary_questions: Describe the step-by-step procedure for upgrading an AOG demand to an occurrence signal.
Explain the specific actions required to raise an AOG clearance signal after resolution.
Identify the key follow-up actions an engineer must take after raising an AOG signal.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the follow-up actions for AOG by respective authorities (Depot, HQNA, NHQ) as covered in the next lesson plan (LP 15).

pft_rows.syllabus: Brief about follow up action for AOG by respective authority viz, Depot, HQNA, NHQ
